#Load packages
```{r setup, echo=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(beepr)
library(data.table)
library(here) #set WD as folder where the file is (not technically necessary for an .Rmd file but helpful for an R script)
```

#Read in and clean SHELDUS
I used the following settings in my query:

Search By: Location and Dates
Adjustment Year: 2022
States: SOUTH CAROLINA
Counties: All
Date Range: 2012-01-01 to 2021-12-31
Hazards & Perils: All
Loss Types: Fatalities, Injuries, Property Losses
Aggregate By: [none] (this is to get the Raw records)
```{r}
sheldus <- read_csv("direct_loss_raw_output.csv")

colnames(sheldus)
```

##Summarize rows within county with the same start and end date
```{r}
gc()

sheldus_clean <- sheldus%>%
  #head(1000)%>% #to test
  group_by(County_FIPS, StartDate, EndDate)%>%
  summarize(Hazard=paste(unique(Hazard), collapse = ";"),
            Month = mean(Month),
            Quarter = mean(Quarter),
            Year = mean(Year),
            Duration_Days = mean(Duration_Days),
            Fatalities= sum(Fatalities),
            FatalitiesPerCapita = sum(FatalitiesPerCapita),
            Injuries=sum(Injuries),
            InjuriesPerCapita=sum(InjuriesPerCapita),
            CropDmg=sum(CropDmg),
            CropDmgAdj=sum(`CropDmg(ADJ)`),
            CropDmgPerCapita=sum(CropDmgPerCapita),
            PropertyDmg=sum(PropertyDmg),
            PropertyDmgAdj=sum(`PropertyDmg(ADJ)`),
            PropertyDmgPerCapita=sum(PropertyDmgPerCapita),
            n=n()
              )%>%
  ungroup()

table(sheldus_clean$Injuries>0)

beep() #beeps when chunk is done running
```

## add column for each hazard 
dummy variable 
```{r}
table(sheldus$Hazard)

# Define the list of hazard types
hazard_types <- c(
  "Avalanche", "Coastal", "Drought", "Earthquake", "Flood", 
  "Fog", "Hail", "Heat", "Hurricane/Tropical Storm", "Landslide", 
  "Lightning", "Severe Storm/Thunder Storm", "Tornado", "Tsunami/Seiche", 
  "Volcano", "Wildfire", "Wind", "Winter Weather"
)

# Create dummy variables for each hazard type
# Using grepl to check if each hazard type appears in the Hazard column
for (hazard in hazard_types) {
  # Create column name (replace spaces and slashes with underscores)
  col_name <- paste0("hazard_", gsub("[/ ]", "_", tolower(hazard)))
  
  # Create dummy variable (1 if hazard present, 0 if not)
  sheldus_clean[[col_name]] <- as.integer(grepl(hazard, sheldus_clean$Hazard, ignore.case = TRUE))
}

beep() #beeps when chunk is done running
# View the first few rows with new columns
head(sheldus_clean)
colnames(sheldus_clean)
```


##prep SHELDUS for join using data.table
Duplicate the start date variable, since that is what will be used for the join using the data.table package
```{r}
sheldus_clean<-sheldus_clean%>%
  mutate(StartDate2 = StartDate, #to be able to identify max/min when also using it as a filtering criteria in data.table join
         )
```

# Simulate analytic file (by participant-wave file)
AI Disclaimer: data simulation code developed using Claude
```{r}
set.seed(2026)

# ---- Settings ---------------------------------------------------------------
n_resp   <- 1000                                   #number of respondents in sample
n_waves  <- 5                                     #number of waves
p_died   <- 0.60                                  # share of those lost-to-followup who died
p_couple<-0.30
haz      <- c(NA, runif(n_waves - 1, 0.03, 0.08)) # wave-specific attrition (5-10%)

# South Carolina county FIPS - pull from SHELDUS and sample to include some counties 
sc_fips    <- sample(unique(sheldus$County_FIPS), size=30) 

# ---- Respondent-level frame (70 households: 30 couples + 40 singles) --------
hh <- tibble(
  HHID   = sprintf("%06d", sample(100000:999999, n_resp*.70)),
  n_pn   = c(rep(2, n_resp*p_couple), rep(1, n_resp*.40)),
  County_base = sample(sc_fips, n_resp - n_resp*p_couple, replace = TRUE) # all 30 used
)

resp <- hh |>
  uncount(n_pn) |>
  group_by(HHID) |>
  mutate(PN = sprintf("%03d", 9 + row_number())) |>   # 010, 011
  ungroup()

stopifnot(nrow(resp) == n_resp)

# ---- Simulate attrition (monotone: once lost, stays lost) -------------------
last_wave <- function() {
  last <- 1
  for (w in 2:n_waves) {
    if (runif(1) < haz[w]) break
    last <- w
  }
  last
}

resp <- resp |>
  mutate(
    last_wave = map_int(seq_len(n()), \(i) last_wave()),
    attrited  = last_wave < n_waves,
    dead      = attrited & (rbinom(n(), 1, p_died) == 1)
  )

# ---- Simulate moves: 10% of respondents move counties exactly once ----------
# Movers are drawn from respondents observed beyond Wave 1, and the move wave
# is the first wave at which the new county is observed (so the move is
# actually visible in the data).
n_movers  <- round(0.10 * n_resp)
mover_idx <- sample(which(resp$last_wave >= 2), n_movers)

resp$move_wave <- NA_integer_
resp$move_wave[mover_idx] <-
  map_int(resp$last_wave[mover_idx], \(l) 1L + sample.int(l - 1, 1))

resp$County_new <- NA_integer_
resp$County_new[mover_idx] <-
  map_int(resp$County_base[mover_idx], \(c) sample(setdiff(sc_fips, c), 1))

# ---- Expand to long format --------------------------------------------------
dat <- resp |>
  crossing(Wave = 1:n_waves) |>
  arrange(HHID, PN, Wave) |>
  mutate(
    Year = 2012 + 2 * (Wave - 1),
    inw = as.integer(Wave <= last_wave),
    died = as.integer(dead & inw == 0),
    County = if_else(!is.na(move_wave) & Wave >= move_wave,
                     County_new, County_base),
    Interview_date = if_else(
      inw == 1,
      as.Date(paste0(Year, "-01-01")) + sample(0:364, n(), replace = TRUE),
      as.Date(NA)
    )
  ) |>
  select(HHID, PN, Wave, Year, Interview_date, County, inw, died)

# ---- Checks -----------------------------------------------------------------
dat |> count(Wave, inw) |> pivot_wider(names_from = inw, values_from = n)

dat |>
  group_by(Wave) |>
  summarise(n_in = sum(inw), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(pct_lost = round(100 * (1 - n_in / lag(n_in)), 1))

# share of attriters (by respondent) who died
resp |> filter(attrited) |> summarise(pct_died = mean(dead))

n_distinct(dat$County)

# movers: share of respondents whose county changes, and number of changes each
dat |>
  group_by(HHID, PN) |>
  summarise(n_moves = sum(County != lag(County), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  count(n_moves) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n))
head(dat, 12)

analyticfile_county<-dat 
```

#Lag interview date and county to indicate mover waves
```{r}
#First create a variable "county_lag_same" that indicates whether a respondent moved
analyticfile_county<-analyticfile_county%>%
  group_by(HHID,PN)%>% #group by person
  arrange(Wave)%>% #arrange waves in temporal order
  mutate(Interview_date_lag = lag(Interview_date),
         Interview_date_midpt = if_else(!is.na(Interview_date_lag), Interview_date_lag + (Interview_date - Interview_date_lag) / 2, NA),
         County_lag = lag(County),
         county_lag_same = if_else(County ==lag(County),1,0), #check if current county is same as previous
         )%>% 
  ungroup()

#assess this variable
##Check: the number of NA should be equal to the number of respondents since it corresponds to the first wave of observation (no prior observed location to be lagged). In practice, this could change if respondents have missing locations in their first wave or location history prior to first wave of observation (ideal!).
table(analyticfile_county$county_lag_same, useNA = "always")

analyticfile_county<-analyticfile_county%>%
  mutate(mover = if_else(county_lag_same==1,0,1),
         exposurelinktype = case_when(
                      Wave==1  & inw==1 ~ 1, #first wave (if don't know location pre-recruitment)
                      county_lag_same==T & inw==1 ~ 2, #nonmover waves
                      county_lag_same==F & inw==1 ~ 3, #mover waves
                      county_lag_same==T & inw==0 & died==1 ~ 4, #death nonmover waves
                      county_lag_same==F & inw==0 & died==1 ~ 5, #death mover waves
                      ),
         wave_losttofollowup = if_else(inw==0 & died==1, 1, NA), #loss to follow up 
         Interview_date_2yr = Interview_date-730, #2 yrs prior
         Interview_date_2yrafter = Interview_date+730 #2 yrs prior
         )

#Check: Table of exposure link type
##NOTE: in this simulated data there are no "death mover" waves but this can happen: a respondent may move between their last interview and their death and this move is captured in their exit interview
table(analyticfile_county$exposurelinktype, useNA = "always")

table(analyticfile_county$wave_losttofollowup, useNA = "always")
```

# Link Disaster Data to participants

##Optional: filter SHELDUS to only counties in longitudinal dataset
```{r}
counties <- unique(analyticfile_county$County)

sheldus_clean_filtered <- sheldus_clean%>%
  #head(10000)%>%
  filter(County_FIPS %in% counties)

#check that all counties in sample show up in SHELDUS
SHELDUScounties <- unique(sheldus_clean_filtered$County_FIPS)

analyticfile_county<- analyticfile_county%>%
  mutate(countyinSHELDUS = if_else(County %in% SHELDUScounties,1,0),
         countyinFEMA = if_else(County %in% SHELDUScounties,1,0))

table(is.na(analyticfile_county$County))
#NAs come from participants who had no location in any wave and will be excluded, not relevant for simulared data 

table(analyticfile_county$countyinSHELDUS)
```


#Join
##data.table approach for speed

```{r}
colnames(analyticfile_county)
sheldus_dt <- as.data.table(sheldus_clean_filtered)
analytic_dt <- as.data.table(analyticfile_county) # %>%head(1000) #to test
analytic_firstwave <-analytic_dt[exposurelinktype==1] 
analytic_alivenonmovers <-analytic_dt[exposurelinktype==2] 
analytic_alivemovers <-analytic_dt[exposurelinktype==3]
analytic_deadnonmovers <-analytic_dt[exposurelinktype==4] 
analytic_deadmovers <-analytic_dt[exposurelinktype==5]
analytic_LTF <-analytic_dt[wave_losttofollowup==1]
```

#SHELDUS for each data.table for each exposure link type
for each file, 
specify begin date of interval - all: prev interview date (lag)
specify end date of interval - alive: interview date, dead: death date (if relevant)

The (debatable) assumption made here is that for people who moved in between interview observations, they moved at the midpoint of their previous and current interview dates.

```{r, warning=F}
gc() #clear working memory before running

#first wave
result_firstwave<- sheldus_dt[analytic_firstwave, 
                    .(HHID=HHID,
                      PN=PN,
                      Wave=Wave,
                      exposurelinktype=exposurelinktype,
                      Interview_date=Interview_date,
                      Interview_date_lag=Interview_date_lag,
                      count=.N,
                      count_hurricane = sum(hazard_hurricane_tropical_storm==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_tornado = sum(hazard_tornado==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_wildfire = sum(hazard_wildfire==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_flood = sum(hazard_flood==1 & hazard_hurricane_tropical_storm==0, na.rm = T),
                      count_winter = sum(hazard_winter_weather==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_propdamage1mil = sum(PropertyDmg>1000000, na.rm = T),
                      count_propdamage10pc = sum(PropertyDmgPerCapita>=10, na.rm = T),
                      count_propdamage50pc = sum(PropertyDmgPerCapita>=50, na.rm = T),
                      date_earliestdisaster = min(StartDate2, na.rm = T),
                      date_earliestdisaster_prop50pc = min(StartDate2[PropertyDmgPerCapita>=50], na.rm = T),
                      date_latestdisaster_prop50pc = max(StartDate2[PropertyDmgPerCapita>=50], na.rm = T),
                      date_latestdisaster = max(StartDate2, na.rm = T)
                      ),
                    on= .(County_FIPS ==County,
                          StartDate>=Interview_date_2yr, #two years prior
                          StartDate<Interview_date #start date falls in window
                          #ensures events are only counted once, based on start date
                          ),
                    by= .EACHI
                    ]

result_firstwave<-result_firstwave%>%
  select(-starts_with("StartDate"))

#Alive non movers
result_alivenonmovers<- sheldus_dt[analytic_alivenonmovers, 
                    .(HHID=HHID,
                      PN=PN,
                      Wave=Wave,
                      exposurelinktype=exposurelinktype,
                      Interview_date=Interview_date,
                      Interview_date_lag=Interview_date_lag,
                      count=.N,
                      count_hurricane = sum(hazard_hurricane_tropical_storm==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_tornado = sum(hazard_tornado==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_wildfire = sum(hazard_wildfire==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_flood = sum(hazard_flood==1 & hazard_hurricane_tropical_storm==0, na.rm = T),
                      count_winter = sum(hazard_winter_weather==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_propdamage1mil = sum(PropertyDmg>1000000, na.rm = T),
                      count_propdamage10pc = sum(PropertyDmgPerCapita>=10, na.rm = T),
                      count_propdamage50pc = sum(PropertyDmgPerCapita>=50, na.rm = T),
                      date_earliestdisaster = min(StartDate2, na.rm = T),
                      date_earliestdisaster_prop50pc = min(StartDate2[PropertyDmgPerCapita>=50], na.rm = T),
                      date_latestdisaster_prop50pc = max(StartDate2[PropertyDmgPerCapita>=50], na.rm = T),
                      date_latestdisaster = max(StartDate2, na.rm = T)
                      ),
                    on= .(County_FIPS ==County,
                          StartDate>=Interview_date_lag, #two years prior
                          StartDate<Interview_date #start date falls in window
                          #ensures events are only counted once, based on start date
                          ),
                    by= .EACHI
                    ]

result_alivenonmovers<-result_alivenonmovers%>%
  select(-starts_with("StartDate"))

#quick checks
table(is.na(result_alivenonmovers$Interview_date_lag))
table(result_alivenonmovers$count>0)
table(result_alivenonmovers$count_propdamage50pc>0)
table(result_alivenonmovers$date_earliestdisaster_prop50pc)

#Alive movers
#half time for previous county
result_alivemovers_firsthalf<- sheldus_dt[analytic_alivemovers, 
                    .(HHID=HHID,
                      PN=PN,
                      Wave=Wave,
                      exposurelinktype=exposurelinktype,
                      Interview_date=Interview_date,
                      Interview_date_lag=Interview_date_lag,
                      count=.N,
                      count_hurricane = sum(hazard_hurricane_tropical_storm==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_tornado = sum(hazard_tornado==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_wildfire = sum(hazard_wildfire==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_flood = sum(hazard_flood==1 & hazard_hurricane_tropical_storm==0, na.rm = T),
                      count_winter = sum(hazard_winter_weather==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_propdamage1mil = sum(PropertyDmg>1000000, na.rm = T),
                      count_propdamage10pc = sum(PropertyDmgPerCapita>=10, na.rm = T),
                      count_propdamage50pc = sum(PropertyDmgPerCapita>=50, na.rm = T),
                      date_earliestdisaster = min(StartDate2, na.rm = T),
                      date_earliestdisaster_prop50pc = min(StartDate2[PropertyDmgPerCapita>=50], na.rm = T),
                      date_latestdisaster_prop50pc = max(StartDate2[PropertyDmgPerCapita>=50], na.rm = T),
                      date_latestdisaster = max(StartDate2, na.rm = T)
                      ),
                    on= .(
                      County_FIPS == County_lag,
                          StartDate>=Interview_date_lag ,
                          StartDate<Interview_date_midpt #start date falls in window
                          #ensures events are only counted once, based on start date
                          ),
                    by= .EACHI
                    ]
#half time for current county
result_alivemovers_secondhalf<- sheldus_dt[analytic_alivemovers, 
                    .(HHID=HHID,
                      PN=PN,
                      Wave=Wave,
                      exposurelinktype=exposurelinktype,
                      Interview_date=Interview_date,
                      Interview_date_lag=Interview_date_lag,
                      count=.N,
                      count_hurricane = sum(hazard_hurricane_tropical_storm==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_tornado = sum(hazard_tornado==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_wildfire = sum(hazard_wildfire==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_flood = sum(hazard_flood==1 & hazard_hurricane_tropical_storm==0, na.rm = T),
                      count_winter = sum(hazard_winter_weather==1, na.rm = T),
                      count_propdamage1mil = sum(PropertyDmg>1000000, na.rm = T),
                      count_propdamage10pc = sum(PropertyDmgPerCapita>=10, na.rm = T),
                      count_propdamage50pc = sum(PropertyDmgPerCapita>=50, na.rm = T),
                      date_earliestdisaster = min(StartDate2, na.rm = T),
                      date_earliestdisaster_prop50pc = min(StartDate2[PropertyDmgPerCapita>=50], na.rm = T),
                      date_latestdisaster_prop50pc = max(StartDate2[PropertyDmgPerCapita>=50], na.rm = T),
                      date_latestdisaster = max(StartDate2, na.rm = T)
                      ),
                    on= .(County_FIPS == County_lag,
                          StartDate>=Interview_date_midpt,
                          StartDate<Interview_date  #start date falls in window
                          #ensures events are only counted once, based on start date
                          ),
                    by= .EACHI
                    ]

#combine them
result_alivemovers<-rbindlist(list(result_alivemovers_firsthalf, result_alivemovers_secondhalf))

result_alivemovers<-result_alivemovers%>%
  select(-starts_with("StartDate"))%>%
  group_by(HHID, PN, Wave,Interview_date,Interview_date_lag,exposurelinktype)%>%
  summarize(n=n(),
            count = sum(count),
            count_propdamage1mil = sum(count_propdamage1mil),
            count_propdamage10pc = sum(count_propdamage10pc),
            count_propdamage50pc = sum(count_propdamage50pc),
            date_earliestdisaster = min(date_earliestdisaster,na.rm=T),
            date_earliestdisaster_prop50pc = min(date_earliestdisaster_prop50pc, na.rm = T),
            date_latestdisaster_prop50pc = max(date_latestdisaster_prop50pc, na.rm = T),
            date_latestdisaster = max(date_latestdisaster,na.rm=T)
            )%>%
  ungroup()

#check
```

# Create a participant level file
```{r}
#participant level file
byhhidpn_sheldus <- result%>%
  group_by(HHID,PN)%>%
  #filter(exposurelinktype!=1)%>%
  summarize(sheldus_evercount = sum(count),
            sheldus_evercountpropdamage50pc = sum(count_propdamage50pc),
            sheldus_evercountpropdamage1mil = sum(count_propdamage1mil),
            sheldus_earliestdisaster = min(date_earliestdisaster, na.rm=T)
            )

head(byhhidpn_sheldus)
```
